title: 第7章 偷天换日第8章 神陨之地
lines: 纸鹤冲破粉雾，但陈大朋的身影紧随其后，狞笑着朝着许平秋扑来。
但眼见就要得手，在这千钧一发之际，陈大朋没由的感到一阵心悸，背后传来令汗毛倒竖的杀意！
本能的，她控制着身形朝下坠去，想要躲避，可四周忽然凭空出现一道道烁亮的金线，织成樊笼，将她困在其中。
这是乐临清金焱燃烧形成的禁制，将她封锁在其中，而远在粉雾之中，乐临清已经蓄势出绝杀的一剑。
金焱焚空，在粉雾之中翻腾咆哮，硬生生烧灼出一片空隙，一道道流火汇聚在乐临清身侧，照彻十方。
哪怕隔着如此之远，陈大朋都能感受到这股灼热。
“会死的！挨了这一剑绝对连渣都不会剩！”
陈大朋眼中只剩下了恐惧，她对着粉雾大喊道:“不…师姐救我！”
但如此情形，蓝雨伯怎么可能出手相助。
先不说能不能扛下，就算是能扛，她头上顶着的也不是肿瘤，胸腔内的心也是又黑又黄，怎么可能替陈大朋挨打？
趁着乐临清动手的空隙重创她不是更妙？
甚至陈大朋那方向的迷神欲雾都收拢起来，蓝雨伯就差没给乐临清喊加油了。
气温的陡然升高也令许平秋睁开了眼，反正眼下全是比利，他觉得应该不至于出事。
甫一睁眼，许平秋就见陈大朋被金线围绕住，灵力慌乱的在体表凝聚出护盾，以及好几种奇奇怪怪不正经的器具被她御使挡在了身前，颇有病急乱投医的感觉。
一声清脆的啼鸣凭空响起，许平秋从未听过这种声响，宛如来自仙古洪荒。
只见乐临清悬立雾中宛若神女，剑锋跃起金色神鸟，挥动着燃烧的翎羽，扑向陈大朋。
金乌啼鸣，为不祥之兆，这对于陈大朋来说也确实是判了死刑。
但乐临清身上的灵力和火焰也瞬间消散，像是在挥出这一剑后有些灵力不济。
下一刻，粉雾几乎化成了实质，铺天盖地的压向了乐临清，遮蔽了许平秋的视线。
即使看不清，粉雾之中的杀机也昭然若揭，这令许平秋不免担心了起来。
但裹挟着死亡气息的金乌扑在陈大朋的身上却有形无实，如同幻象一般破灭。
甚至只是令她凝聚的护盾晃荡了一下，并没有造成更实质的伤害。
这令陈大朋不免愣住了，双手上下来回抚摸，似乎有些想不清自己为什么没有噶，而许平秋则不免庆幸乐临清这个时候是不憨的。
霎时间，一道道更加耀眼的金光于粉雾中绽放。
片刻后，蓝雨伯的身形从粉雾中溃逃而出，右臂齐肩而断，断口处还在滋滋作响，金焱顺着伤口攀附而上，将她肌肤烧得焦黑开裂，哀嚎不止。
但乐临清的情况也不太妙，只见她神色有些恍惚，勉强御剑向着纸鹤飞来，脸色变得十分红润，紧咬着嘴唇像是在压抑着什么。
途经陈大朋的时候，她还是勉强又挥出了一剑，但这个家伙看见蓝雨伯受重创的时候就已经向着远处跑路，剑气未能伤到她。
乐临清身形有些踉跄的落在了纸鹤上，长剑也掉落在一旁，她已经无暇去收，而是拿出了一枚丹药开始吞服。
但即使吞服了丹药，乐临清脸上的红霞也未衰退，如同日落晚霞时的火烧云，一路向下蔓延，顺着鹅颈隐于衣襟之中，戛然而止。
而她眼眸也不再燃烧着金焱，而是泛起迷蒙的水光，纤长的睫毛微微颤动着。
此刻的乐临清无疑比刚刚天魔的景象更加诱人，甚至有种一推就倒的错觉。
“你怎么样，没事吧？”许平秋看着一脸意乱的乐临清，有些担忧的问道。
“有，有事，别，别碰到我了……”乐临清声音发颤绵软，说出这几个字时，都已经显得有些艰难。
content_en:
The paper crane broke through the pink mist, but Chen Dapeng's figure followed closely behind, charging toward Xu Pingqiu with a grin.
But when he saw that he was about to succeed, at this critical moment, Chen Dapeng couldn't help but feel palpitations in his heart, and there was a murderous intention behind him that made his hair stand on end!
Instinctively, she controlled her body to fall downwards, trying to escape, but suddenly bright golden threads appeared out of thin air all around, weaving into a cage, trapping her in it.
This was the restriction formed by the burning of Le Linqing's golden flame, which sealed her inside. But far away in the powder mist, Le Linqing had already prepared a killing sword.
The golden flame burned in the sky, roaring in the powder mist, burning out a gap, and streams of fire gathered around Le Linqing's side, illuminating all directions.
Even from such a distance, Chen Dapeng could feel the burning heat.
"You will die! If you take this sword, you will definitely not be left alive!"
There was only fear in Chen Dapeng's eyes, and she shouted to Fenwu: "No...Senior sister, save me!"
But in such a situation, how could Lan Yubo help.
Let's not talk about whether she can carry it. Even if she can, the thing on her head is not a tumor, and the heart in her chest is black and yellow. How can she be beaten for Chen Dapeng?
Wouldn't it be better to take advantage of Le Linqing's opportunity to hit her hard?
Even the ecstasy in Chen Dapeng's direction had gathered, and Lan Yubo almost stopped shouting cheers for Le Linqing.
The sudden rise in temperature also made Xu Pingqiu open his eyes. Anyway, it was all Billy in front of him, so he felt that nothing would happen.
As soon as she opened her eyes, Xu Pingqiu saw that Chen Dapeng was surrounded by golden threads, his spiritual power was condensing into a shield on his body in a panic, and several strange and unorthodox instruments were blocked in front of him by her emissary. It felt like he was in a hurry to seek medical treatment.
A crisp cry sounded out of thin air. Xu Pingqiu had never heard such a sound before, as if it came from ancient times.
I saw Le Linqing hanging in the fog like a goddess, with a golden divine bird leaping from the sword edge, waving its burning feathers, and pounced on Chen Dapeng.
The crow of the golden crow is an ominous sign, which is indeed a death sentence for Chen Dapeng.
But the spiritual power and flames on Le Linqing's body also dissipated instantly, as if he had lost some spiritual power after swinging the sword.
The next moment, the pink mist almost turned into substance, overwhelmingly pressing on Le Linqing, blocking Xu Pingqiu's sight.
Even if he couldn't see clearly, the murderous intention was still obvious in the pink mist, which made Xu Pingqiu worried.
But the golden crow, carrying the aura of death, pounced on Chen Dapeng, but it was invisible and shattered like an illusion.
It even just caused her condensed shield to sway, but did not cause any more substantial damage.
This made Chen Dapeng stunned. He stroked his hands up and down, as if he couldn't figure out why he didn't have it. Xu Pingqiu couldn't help but feel glad that Le Linqing was not stupid at this time.
In an instant, more dazzling golden light bloomed in the pink mist.
A moment later, Lan Yubo's figure burst out of the pink mist. Her right arm was broken at shoulder level, and the fracture was still sizzling. Jin Yan climbed up along the wound, burning her skin black and cracking, making her wail endlessly.
But Le Linqing's situation was not good either. She looked a little dazed and reluctantly flew towards the paper crane with her sword. Her face became very rosy and she bit her lips tightly as if she was suppressing something.
When passing by Chen Dapeng, she reluctantly swung her sword again, but the guy had already run away when he saw Lan Yubo was seriously injured, and the sword energy failed to hurt her.
Le Linqing staggered and landed on the paper crane, and the long sword also fell aside. She had no time to collect it, but took out a pill and started to swallow it.
But even after swallowing the elixir, the red glow on Le Linqing's face did not fade away. Like the burning clouds at sunset, it spread all the way down, hidden in the skirt of clothes along the goose neck, and stopped abruptly.
And her eyes were no longer burning with golden flames, but were filled with misty water, and her long eyelashes were trembling slightly.
The sight of Le Linqing at this moment was undoubtedly more alluring than the sight of the demon just now, and he even had the illusion that he would fall down with just one push.
"How are you, are you okay?" Xu Pingqiu looked at the confused Le Linqing and asked with some worry.
"Yes, something's wrong, don't, don't touch me..." Le Linqing's voice was trembling and soft, and it was already difficult to say these words.
title_en: Chapter 7: Stealing Heaven and Swapping Sun Chapter 8: The Land of God’s Death
